name: UrbanSound8K
description: UrbanSound8K contains 8,732 labeled urban sound excerpts (under 4 seconds) across 10 classes: air_conditioner, car_horn, children_playing, dog_bark, drilling, engine_idling, gun_shot, jackhammer, siren, and street_music. Files are organized into 10 standardized cross-validation folds.
